title: Reader: add minimal admin HTTP server exposing /metrics
description: Reader has prometheus crate and metrics.rs (NNTP command latency already instrumented) but no HTTP server. Add a minimal tokio-based HTTP server (same pattern as transit admin.rs) that listens on a configurable admin_addr (default 127.0.0.1:8082), responds to GET /metrics with prometheus text format, requires bearer token if configured. Wire in main.rs alongside the NNTP accept loops.
